linkedin.content:
A meeting summary is useful for a day. A decision trail can stay useful after the team changes.

I built a small English/Mandarin proof that keeps the scripted transcript immutable, turns it into ten typed knowledge units, and lets every confirmed item reopen the exact speaker, timestamp, and excerpt. Corrections stay in the history as superseded versions instead of silently replacing the source.

The boundary matters: this is a scripted, manually reviewed project proof—not a claim about real-room ASR, automatic extraction, or a customer deployment.

You can inspect the chain and download the portable JSON here:
lazying.art/meeting-intelligence/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=meeting_intelligence&utm_content=evidence_chain

If you are testing this with rights-cleared meeting audio, start with one representative recording and measure the names, numbers, speakers, and timestamps before choosing the larger architecture.

#KnowledgeManagement #LocalAI #MultilingualAI #OpenSource
